title: Trials of Mastery Stats: stats table
description: Group, default base, race adjustments and effects per stat (ST-3, ST-9, ST-21, ST-27). Every core stat needs an entry.

group.description: The stat box group (ST-21). A stat without a group is in "Other".

raceAdjustments.description: Relative adjustments of the base, keyed by the race's editor ID, e.g. "NordRace" (ST-3). Races without an entry get none.

effects.description: The stat's effects, keyed by a name of the file's choice.

effect.description: An actor-value effect (ST-10) or a named effect of the module (ST-11 to ST-13), with its curve.

actorValue.description: The actor value as the game names it, e.g. "Health".
